title: The Tabby Cat
phrases: a dark M on the forehead

doing.t: is asleep with one paw over its eyes
is dozing with its tail wrapped round its feet
is sitting with all four paws tucked under it
is sitting up tall with its ears pricked forward
is kneading a crocheted blanket with its front paws

close: Just the tabby, side on, filling the page.
Only the cat's face, with the M on its forehead in the middle of the page.

roles.dark: for the stripes and the eyes
roles.light: for the chin, the chest and the whiskers
roles.accent: for the pink nose and the insides of the ears

firstMark: Start with the M on the forehead in short, sharp strokes of {dark}.
Start with the stripes: a few curved bands of {dark} that wrap round the body, drawn lightly.

title: The Ginger Kitten

doing.t: is batting at a ball of wool with one paw
is chasing the tip of its own tail
is asleep on its back with its paws in the air
is peeping out of a paper bag
is pouncing on a fallen leaf

close: Just the kitten, drawn big, with nothing behind it.
Only the kitten's face, drawn so big that the whiskers run off the page.

roles.dark: for the eyes and the deepest stripes
roles.light: for the cream chin and paws
roles.accent: for the pink nose and paw pads

firstMark: Start with the ears: two pointed triangles of {main}, set wide apart.
Start with the striped tail in short, curved bands of {main}.

title: The Black Cat
phrases: a blue shine along the back

doing.t: is sitting very upright with its tail over its toes
is staring up with wide green eyes
is washing one back leg stuck up in the air
is walking along with its tail held straight up
is winding round a pair of muddy wellies

close: Just the black cat, with a thin rim of light along its back.
Only the cat's face, with its two green eyes in the middle of the page.

roles.dark: for the deepest shadow under the chin and belly
roles.light: for the blue shine on the back and the whiskers

firstMark: Start with the shine: leave a strip of bare paper along the back, then lay {main} all around it.
Start with the green eyes, then build {main} up around them so the green stands out.

title: The Springer Spaniel

doing.t: is shaking itself dry with its ears flying
is carrying a stick far too big for it
is sitting and looking up with big brown eyes
is lying flat out on its side, fast asleep
is sniffing the ground with its tail wagging

close: Just the spaniel's head, curly ears and all.
Only the spaniel, side on, from its nose to its tail.

roles.main: for the dark brown ears and patches
roles.dark: for the nose, the eyes and the curls on the ears
roles.light: for the white face and the freckled legs

firstMark: Start with the nose: a damp, shiny shape of {dark}, with a speck of paper left for the gleam.
Start with the ears in loose, looping curls of {main}.

title: The Dachshund
phrases: a long body on short legs

doing.t: is trotting along with its ears bouncing
is sitting up to beg with its front paws dangling
is lying stretched out flat on its tummy
is under a blanket with only its tail showing
is wearing a stripy knitted jumper

close: Just the dachshund, side on, stretching all the way across the page.
Only the dachshund's head, with its long ears hanging down.

roles.dark: for the eyes, the nose and the shadow under the long belly
roles.light: for the shine along the back

firstMark: Start with the long line of the back in one light, unbroken stroke of {main}.
Start with the nose: a shiny dot of {dark} at the very tip of the long snout.

title: The Old Sheepdog
phrases: one ear up, one ear down

doing.t: is lying chin on paws with one eye open
is fast asleep on its side, legs stretched out
is lying down and wagging its tail
is sitting up straight with its head held high
is crouched low, staring at a hen

close: Just the old dog's head, with its grey muzzle and brown eyes.
Only the sheepdog, drawn big, with nothing behind it.

roles.dark: for the deepest fur and the nose
roles.light: for the white chest and paws

firstMark: Start with the eyes: two warm brown circles, each ringed with {dark}.
Start with the white chest: colour {main} round it and leave the white as bare paper.

title: The Speckled Hen

doing.t: is scratching about with one foot raised
is standing beside a freshly laid egg
is tilting her head to look at a beetle
is taking a dust bath with her wings spread out
is sitting on a nest of eggs

close: Just the hen, side on, with every speckle drawn.
Only the hen's head, with her red comb and her orange eye.

roles.dark: for the black bar near the tip of each feather

firstMark: Start with the eye: a small orange circle with a dot of {dark} in the middle.
Start with the speckles: leave small dots of bare paper and work {main} in around each one.

title: The Box of Chicks

doing.t: has every chick looking up with its beak open
has the chicks huddled together, fast asleep
has one chick trying to climb over the side
has one chick standing on another's back

close: Just one chick from the box, round and fluffy, drawn big.
Only the box, seen from above, with the chicks inside.

roles.dark: for the eyes and the shadows in the box
roles.light: for the fluffiest tops of the heads
roles.accent: for the orange beaks and feet

firstMark: Start with the eyes: one sharp dot of {dark} for each chick, before any fluff.
Start with the inside corners of the box in {dark}, so the yellow chicks stand out against it.

title: The Lamb

doing.t: is jumping straight up with all four legs stiff
is drinking milk from a bottle, tail wagging
is lying down with its legs tucked beneath it
is head-butting its twin
is bleating with its mouth wide open

close: Just the lamb, side on, from its nose to its tail.
Only the lamb's face, with its ears sticking straight out sideways.

roles.dark: for the eyes, the nostrils and the shadows between the curls
roles.light: for the tops of the curls
roles.accent: for the pink inside the ears

firstMark: Start with the fleece in small, loose circles of {main}, like a row of curls.
Start with the eyes: two dark sideways ovals of {dark}, set wide apart on the face.

title: The Spotted Pig

doing.t: is nosing about with its snout down
is trotting along on its small pointed feet
is munching an apple with its eyes half closed
is snoozing with its ears flopped over its eyes
is wallowing in mud up to its chin

close: Just the pig's face, snout first, with its ears tipped forward.
Only the pig, side on, from the end of its snout to the curl of its tail.

roles.dark: for the black spots and the shadow under the belly
roles.light: for the light along the back and ears

firstMark: Start with the snout: a flat oval with two nostrils of {dark}.
Start with the spots as soft-edged patches of {dark}, then bring the pink up to meet them.

title: The Highland Cow

doing.t: is peering out through its fringe
is chewing, with grass sticking out of its mouth
is lying down with its legs folded under
is licking its nose with its long tongue
is standing beside its fluffy calf

close: Just the cow's head, from the tips of its horns to its wet black nose.
Only the cow, side on, from its horns to its tail.

roles.dark: for the deep shadows in the coat and under the fringe
roles.light: for the pale horns and the sunlit tips of the hair

firstMark: Start with the fringe in long, downward flicks of {main}, falling over where the eyes would be.
Start with the nose: a broad, damp shape of {dark} peeping out below all that hair.

title: The Baby Goat
phrases: a dark stripe down the back

doing.t: is balancing on top of an upturned bucket
is bouncing sideways on stiff legs
is nibbling the frayed end of a rope
is bleating with its tongue sticking out
is standing on its back legs to reach a leaf

close: Just the baby goat, side on, on its long thin legs.
Only the baby goat's face, looking straight at you.

roles.dark: for the eyes, the hooves and the stripe down the back
roles.light: for the white face markings and legs
roles.accent: for the pink inside the long ears

firstMark: Start with the eye: a pale yellow oval with a flat bar of {dark} across the middle.
Start with the legs: four thin, knobbly lines of {main}, then draw the body on top of them.

title: The Donkey
phrases: a dark cross on its back

doing.t: is dozing with one back hoof tipped up
is braying with its lips curled back
is resting its head on another donkey's neck
is rolling on its back with its legs in the air
is nibbling a purple thistle

close: Just the donkey's head, ears and all, looking straight out of the page.
Only the donkey's pale nose and whiskers, close up.

roles.dark: for the cross on the back, the tips of the ears and the hooves
roles.light: for the pale nose and the rings round the eyes

firstMark: Start with the long ears in two upright strokes of {main}, tipped with {dark}.
Start with the dark cross: one line down the spine and one across the shoulders in {dark}.

title: The Floppy-Eared Rabbit

doing.t: is leaping in the air with its back legs kicking
is flopped on its side with its eyes half shut
is nibbling a sprig of parsley
is nudging a cardboard tube along with its nose
is sitting up on its back legs, sniffing

close: Just the rabbit, side on, with its ears hanging down past its chin.
Only the rabbit's face, between its two long, drooping ears.

roles.dark: for the eye and the shadows under the ears
roles.light: for the pale belly and the fluffy tail
roles.accent: for the pink nose and the insides of the ears

firstMark: Start with the ears: two long, drooping shapes of {main} hanging down past the chin.
Start with the two round cheeks either side of the nose, shaded underneath with {dark}.

title: The Guinea Pig

doing.t: is munching a long stalk of hay
is chomping on a slice of cucumber
is touching noses with another guinea pig
is jumping straight up in the air

close: Just the guinea pig, side on, from its nose to its round back end.
Only the guinea pig's face, with its round eyes and whiskers.

roles.dark: for the black patches and the eyes
roles.light: for the white patches and the fluffiest fur
roles.accent: for the pink feet and ears

firstMark: Start with the outline as one lumpy, potato-shaped line of {main}.
Start with the eye: a shiny black dot of {dark}, set high on the side of the head.

title: The Goldfish

doing.t: is blowing a line of small bubbles
is swimming up to a flake of food
is floating still with its fins spread
is swimming through the arch of a toy castle
is looking out with its nose against the glass

close: Just the goldfish, side on, with its tail fanned out behind it.
Only the bowl and its fish, with the window reflected in the curve of the glass.

roles.dark: for the eye and the deepest orange on the back
roles.light: for the shine on the glass and the bubbles

firstMark: Start with the fish in {main}, then draw the bowl round it, so the fish stays big.
Start with the eye: a dot of {dark} inside a small yellow ring.
